messages:
tara_fin: Heads-up: INV-9991 (Thermion) just failed on first attempt. Gateway says 'AVS phone mismatch' and issuer flagged foreign-issued card. Customer needs onboarding access today.

oliver_ae: On with the customer now. They have a corporate card but procurement issues virtual cards from NL. Issuer says they block charges when billing phone is US.

mike_ops: Do we have the exact decline code?

tara_fin: Webhook shows `decline_code: avs_phone_mismatch_country` (gateway: Stripe) at 2026-03-29T15:11Z. Attempt id at_241234.

sam_support: Customer (thermion_cust) in support thread: "We can99submit PO and signed card auth, but procurement won't reissue a physical card until next week. Can you take a wire?"

payments-bot: Auto-retry scheduled in 24h (rty_241234). Recommend pause retry if using manual collection to prevent double-charge.

mike_ops: Short options: 1) secure one-time payment link for a different card, 2) Plaid Instant ACH (if they have a US bank), 3) wire today. Which is fastest for them?

oliver_ae: They prefer not to do a wire if possible. Will Plaid be acceptable? They have a US office with bank account.

tara_fin: If Plaid works, thats fastest. Otherwise wire. I'll pause automatic retry and tag invoice `manual-ops-hold`. @sam_support please ask them to upload PO + signed authorization and confirm Plaid eligibility.

sam_support: Drafting note to customer: "Hi  we can offer Plaid Instant ACH (link) or a secure card entry link (valid 60m). If neither works, we can accept wire. Please upload PO and signed card authorization here: https://support.redwood.ai/portal/upload.

Plaid: https://payments.redwood.ai/collect/plaid/INV-9991
Secure card entry: https://payments.redwood.ai/collect/oneoff/INV-9991

If you'd like wire, please include INV-9991 in the bank reference and upload the remittance once sent."

oliver_ae: Also offered a one-time waiver of the $25 manual-processing fee to unblock onboarding. Customer appreciated that.

mike_ops: Ops actions: 1) log telemetry for `avs_phone_mismatch_country` and capture `card_issuing_country` vs `billing_country`, 2) add a short invoice banner when mismatch risk detected, 3) adjust retry timing to avoid token expiry for virtual cards.

tara_fin: Agreed on telemetry and UI hint. I'll file tracking ticket and monitor the support upload. Once settlement posts, mark invoice paid and remove onboarding hold.

thermion_cust: Reply in support: "We'll try Plaid now and upload PO. If Plaid fails, we'll do wire and send receipt."

payments-bot: Reminder: when marking paid after wire, use `payments:mark-paid INV-9991 txn=<bank_txn_id>` to prevent auto-retry capture.
